brief:
A mosque in al-Dahi, a Palestinian Arab village in northern Israel, was set on fire in a suspected arson attack, Al Jazeera English reported. The incident sparked political criticism directed at Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.

The torching of the mosque intensified tensions within Israel's political landscape, with opposition figures seizing on the attack to challenge the government's handling of community relations and security.

title: Arson attack on Palestinian mosque triggers backlash against Netanyahu
